title: Here is a professional, website-reaCCI Visit to General Hospital Kamba CCI Pays Courtesy and Monitoring Visit to General Hospital Kamba Dandi Concerned Citizens Initiatives (CCI) paid a special visit to General Hospital Kamba to assess the state of medical equipment and engage with the hospital management on issues affecting healthcare service delivery. During the visit, the CCI team met with the Principal Medical Officer (PMO), Dr. Anas Umar Alwasa, and other hospital officials. The team expressed appreciation to the Kebbi State Government for providing essential medical equipment and supporting the improvement of healthcare services at the hospital following its renovation. The visit also provided an opportunity for CCI to strengthen its partnership with healthcare authorities and reaffirm its commitment to promoting accountability, quality healthcare, community participation, and sustainable development across Dandi Local Government Area. CCI appreciates the hospital management and the Kebbi State Government for their cooperation and continued efforts toward improving healthcare services for the people of Dandi.
